{"sql":"WITH q AS (
  SELECT
    symbol,
    MAX(CASE WHEN rk = 1 THEN capex_usd_b END) AS capex_t0,
    MAX(CASE WHEN rk = 1 THEN revenue_usd_b END) AS rev_t0,
    MAX(CASE WHEN rk = 5 THEN capex_usd_b END) AS capex_t4,
    MAX(CASE WHEN rk = 5 THEN revenue_usd_b END) AS rev_t4
  FROM (
    SELECT
      symbol,
      capex_usd_b,
      revenue_usd_b,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY symbol ORDER BY period_end DESC) AS rk
    FROM v_quarter
    WHERE symbol IN ('MSFT', 'GOOGL', 'AMZN', 'META')
  )
  GROUP BY symbol
)
SELECT
  symbol,
  ROUND(capex_t0, 3) AS capex_t0,
  ROUND(rev_t0, 3) AS rev_t0,
  ROUND(capex_t4, 3) AS capex_t4,
  ROUND(rev_t4, 3) AS rev_t4,
  ROUND((capex_t0/rev_t0 - capex_t4/rev_t4)*100, 2) AS diff_pct_points

{"code":"import { runSql } from '../servers/earnings/index.js';

// Calcular a queda trimestre a trimestre para todas as empresas dos EUA
// Usando window functions para pegar o trimestre anterior
const result = await runSql({ sql: `
  WITH ordered AS (
    SELECT 
      symbol,
      name,
      period_end,
      revenue_usd_b,
      LAG(revenue_usd_b) OVER (PARTITION BY symbol ORDER BY period_end) as prev_revenue
    FROM v_quarter
    WHERE market = 'EUA'
  ),
  changes AS (
    SELECT 
      symbol,
      name,
      period_end,
      revenue_usd_b,
      prev_revenue,
      CASE 
        WHEN prev_revenue IS NOT NULL AND prev_revenue > 0 
        THEN ROUND(((revenue_usd_b - prev_revenue) / prev_revenue) * 100, 2)
        ELSE NULL 
      END as qoq_pct_change
    FROM ordered
  )
  SELECT symbol, name, period_end, revenue_usd_b, prev_revenue, qoq_pct_change
  FROM changes
  WHERE qoq_pct_change IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY qoq_pct_change ASC
  LIMIT 10
`});

console.log("Top 10 maiores quedas trimestre a trimestre:");
console.log(JSON.stringify(result.rows, null, 2));
"}
